title: Avoid staging missing already-staged paths
goal: Validate all claimed changed paths, but pass only unstaged and untracked paths to git add. This must allow already-staged deletions and case-only renames, while preserving staged-scope rejection and all commit, signing, merge and hook guards.
checkpoint: Reproduced the defect in a disposable temporary Git repo: staging a deletion then passing that removed path to `git add -A --pathspec-from-file` exited 128 with `fatal: pathspec 'gone.txt' did not match any files`. Implemented `PathChanges { all, to_stage }`: all three existing Git queries and full scope validation remain; only unstaged/untracked paths are sent to `git add`, and the add is skipped for already-staged changes. Validation on Windows at base HEAD 2ae050b534aa10f5ed4195aa50ca3c33987f46fe: focused 8 tests passed, 0 failed, 150 filtered, 3.63s; fmt, diff check, focused Clippy -D warnings passed. Built ordinary launcher target/casefix/debug/local-workflow.exe (SHA256 962C3686D0882A35619661B4DFF7B46A93C9E52F19111B70B0380E3E5D5A758A). Tests cover staged/out-of-scope staged deletions, literal bracket+space path unstaged deletion, staged rename, staged+unstaged revert, mixed final content, Windows case-only rename, and Windows duplicate-case index entry removal. Native local commit e96a45b23e681e0b99ad7c9e7f701084760fad39; not shipped. No nowindow files touched.
